# California Scottish Rite Foundation

> > The California Scottish Rite Foundation provides free and low-cost speech-language therapy to children through RiteCare Childhood Language Centers across California.

CASRF, established in 1958, operates multiple RiteCare centers throughout California dedicated to improving childhood language development and literacy. The organization combines charitable giving with clinical speech-language pathology services to expand healthcare access for underserved communities.

## Key Topics

- RiteCare Childhood Language Centers
- Speech-language therapy
